newsitem.title: ITALY: Specialists bid for 571 bln lire of Italy 30-y Btp.
newsitem.headline: Specialists bid for 571 bln lire of Italy 30-y Btp.

text.p: Specialist bond traders bid for 571 billion lire of 30-year fixed-rate bonds (BTP) against the Italian Treasury's offer of 300 billion lire of paper.
Earlier, the Treasury received bids for 4.358 trillion lire at the open auction for the November 1, 2026 paper, against three trillion lire worth of bonds on offer.
The auction price was set at 90.25 from 89.20 at the previous sale on March 13. Gross yield was 8.28 vs 8.39 percent.
